name: fullcharge-nhtsa-tools
description: Scrape every NHTSA ERG / rescue sheet, download the PDFs, publish them as the FULLCHARGE 'All cut sheets' pack. Runs on your PC, not in the app.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.all: npm run scrape && npm run download && npm run compress && npm run publish
scripts.pictures: npm run logos:find && npm run photos:find
